description: Three contrasting, legally replayed scenarios for release evaluation. Positional and endgame scenarios are illustrative positions, not claimed complete historical games.

scenarios.title: Quiet positional development
scenarios.attribution: Illustrative opening-to-middlegame scenario from the standard starting position
scenarios.focus: Piece coordination, prophylaxis, central tension, avoiding invented tactics

scenarios.title: Opera Game tactical middlegame
scenarios.attribution: Historical illustrative segment from the Opera Game (1858), with complete preceding move history
scenarios.focus: Captures, queen/rook sacrifices, forcing checks and attacking compensation

scenarios.title: King and passed-pawn endgame
scenarios.attribution: Illustrative FEN endgame, not a claimed historical game
scenarios.focus: King support, passed-pawn advances, opposition and legal checks
